nearest.name: Nearest
nearest.desc: Zero-order hold. Produces severe block artefacts and jagged step edges.

bilinear.name: Bilinear
bilinear.desc: First-order filter. Blurs boundary edges and attenuates depth discontinuities.

bicubic.name: Bicubic
bicubic.desc: Polynomial spline. Ringing overshoot and boundary bleeding.

joint_bilateral.name: Joint Bilateral
joint_bilateral.desc: RGB-guided bilateral kernel. Preserves major silhouettes.

guided_filter.name: Guided Filter
guided_filter.desc: Local linear guidance model. Fast O(N) edge transfer.

hybrid.name: DepthLab Hybrid
hybrid.desc: Classical guidance + residual CNN + edge gradient gating.
